title: John Ramirez says everyone is waiting for Elizondo to talk about hybrids

tellings.quote: And then you've got John Ramirez, who in 2022 uh made comments to the effect that everyone is waiting for Lue Elizondo to talk about hybrids.

plain: In 2022, a man named John Ramirez said, roughly, that everyone was waiting for Luis Elizondo, a man prominent in the UFO debate, to talk about hybrids, meaning beings that are part human and part alien. The researcher Jason Simosa brings up the remark on the show as something Ramirez said. Simosa uses it to suggest that people on the inside expect hybrids to be part of what eventually comes out.
